def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_quantity = 150
    final_quantity = 200
    initial_price = 5
    final_price = 4

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    midpoint_quantity = (initial_quantity + final_quantity) / 2
    midpoint_price = (initial_price + final_price) / 2

    percent_change_in_quantity = (
        final_quantity - initial_quantity
    ) / midpoint_quantity
    percent_change_in_price = (
        final_price - initial_price
    ) / midpoint_price

    arc_elasticity = percent_change_in_quantity / percent_change_in_price
    answer = round(arc_elasticity, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
